newsitem.title: USA: Labor Ready Q3 same-store sales up 16 pct.
newsitem.headline: Labor Ready Q3 same-store sales up 16 pct.

text.p: Labor Ready Inc said sales for the third quarter ended September 30 were $47.3 million, up 53 percent from $30.9 million in year-ago period, and same-store sales for the third quarter of 1996 rose 16 percent over same-store sales for the same period last year.
The company said year-to-date sales through September 1996 were $109.4 million, up 73 percent from $63.2 million a year earlier.
Same-store year-to-date sales through September 1996 rose 27 percent over same-store sales a year earlier.
